Hi Samir,

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and next steps:
- You confirmed production usage of our chat endpoint for customer support triage.

Can you confirm that Acme wants a formal 'training-on-customer-data' opt-out? If so, we'll send a short amendment (DPA addendum + opt-out confirmation) and lock logs/retention as discussed. Marissa (cc'd) will handle the formal confirmation and DocuSign.

From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@acmeinc.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T17:03:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Data handling / training-on-customer-data

Hi Rishi,

Yes, Acme confirms we want to opt-out of training-on-customer-data. We need written confirmation that:
- Our raw chat transcripts will not be used for model training or improvement.
- Logs will be retained for 90 days and masked for PII.
- Data will be stored only in EU region (Frankfurt).
- We'll need SOC 2 Type II evidence and encryption KMS details before signing.

Please send the amendment and SOC2 link.

Thanks,
Samir
Head of Security
Acme Inc.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@acmeinc.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-02T09:28:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Follow-up: Data handling / training-on-customer-data

Hi Samir,

Confirmed: Redwood will exclude Acme Inc. from training-on-customer-data for model improvement once the attached DPA amendment is signed. Summary of controls:
- Training opt-out: flag set at account-level; no customer content (chat transcripts, attachments, or derived features) will be included in model training datasets.
- Logs & retention: access logs and request logs will be stored in EU (Frankfurt) and retained for 90 days. Logs containing PII will be redacted/highlighted per our PII redaction pipeline; we can also set additional masking rules if you provide a sample set.
- Encryption & keys: customer data at rest is encrypted with AES-256; we offer customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) for enterprise plans.
- Evidence: SOC 2 Type II report (link below) and our security questionnaire are attached.

Attachments: DPA_Amendment_v2.pdf, SOC2_TypeII_report_link.pdf
DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/ACME-REDWOOD-OPT-12345
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/ACME-2027-Q3-001

Next steps:
1) Sign the DPA amendment via DocuSign.
2) We'll enact the opt-out flag and confirm via email when live (usually within 24 hours after countersignature).
3) If you want extended retention or additional masking rules, we'll loop in Revenue Ops to quote.

Let me know if you want a quick call with security to walk the controls.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
